hero.subtitle: From first draft to published post, Markaestro handles every step of your social workflow. One platform, zero context-switching.

coreFeatures.title: Multi-Channel Publishing
coreFeatures.description: Compose once, publish everywhere. Write a single post and adapt it for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads, Pinterest, and X in one click. Schedule for optimal timing or publish instantly.
details: Unified composer with per-channel preview
Drag-and-drop media management
Bulk reschedule, status changes, and deletes
Character limits and media checks per channel before you publish

coreFeatures.title: Media Upload & Library
coreFeatures.description: Bring your own photography, video, and brand assets. Markaestro stores them per workspace and attaches them to posts with a single drop.
details: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4, MOV, and WebM support
Up to 250 MB per video, 10 MB per image
Per-channel format checks before publish
Reuse uploaded media across multiple posts

coreFeatures.title: Multi-Channel Previews
coreFeatures.description: See how every post will look on each network before you publish: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads, Pinterest, and X each get their own preview. Captions, aspect ratios, character limits, and media specs are all rendered live.
details: Per-platform previews, including ad-style placements
Live caption character-count tracking
Media count and format rules per channel
Catch formatting issues before they ship

coreFeatures.title: Publishing Dashboard
coreFeatures.description: See every draft, scheduled post, and publishing state in one workspace view without jumping between platforms.
details: Draft, scheduled, published, and on-platform views
Per-channel publishing status and error detail
To post queue for channels a human posts natively
Workspace-level activity overview on the dashboard

coreFeatures.title: OAuth Integrations
coreFeatures.description: Connect your accounts in one click with industry-standard OAuth. No manual API keys, no token juggling. Markaestro securely stores and refreshes credentials for you.
details: One-click connect for Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads, Pinterest, and X
Encrypted token storage at rest
Automatic token refresh
Granular disconnect per platform

coreFeatures.title: Intelligent Evergreen
coreFeatures.description: Turn a mature, measured post into a recurring policy you control. Rotate approved captions, review every run or pre-approve the queue, and let Markaestro pause the sequence when comparable performance decays.
details: Eligibility backed by the source post's measured results
Fixed or learned timing with DST-safe recurrence
Review-each-run and pre-approved scheduling modes
Seven-day evaluation with a conservative two-run decay pause

coreFeatures.title: API & AI Agents
coreFeatures.description: Everything the dashboard does, your software can do too. Mint an API key, hand it to an AI agent or a script, and let it discover accounts, upload media, schedule posts, publish, and report back, on every paid plan, at no extra cost.
details: Keys scoped to a single brand, with optional expiry
Idempotent writes so a retry never double-posts
Async publish runs, HMAC-signed webhooks, and an MCP server for Claude Code, claude.ai, and Cursor
Manual-first on Meta and TikTok by default: a human posts unless you opt a post in
coreFeatures.codeLabel: Schedule a Post from Anything That Speaks HTTP

platformFeatures.title: Workspace Management
platformFeatures.description: Organize the brands you market, clients, business units, or your own ventures, into isolated workspaces. Each workspace has its own brands, integrations, and team members.

platformFeatures.title: Scheduling & Calendar
platformFeatures.description: Queue posts on a unified calendar across all your channels. Reschedule with a drag, move a batch of posts at once, and keep a clear view of what's going out when.

platformFeatures.title: Role-Based Access
platformFeatures.description: Control who can publish, edit, or view with four roles: Owner, Admin, Member, and Analyst. Keep sensitive settings locked down while your team moves fast.

platformFeatures.title: Brand Profiles
platformFeatures.description: Scan a website to pull the name, description, colours, logo and tone into a brand profile, then refine its voice, identity and knowledge. Every post and every Intelligence draft is grounded in that profile.

platformSection.subtitle: Beyond the core tools, Markaestro gives you the infrastructure to scale, from a single brand to a full client roster.

cta.title: Ready to see it in action?
cta.subtitle: Start for free. No credit card required. Connect your first channel in under two minutes.

intelligence.subtitle: Intelligence reads the posts you already published, keeps every metric exactly as the platforms reported it, and turns that history into plain-language answers, ready-to-edit drafts, and evidence for governed Evergreen queues.

loop.title: Measure
loop.body: Posts published through Markaestro and history imported from your connected accounts become one record per post with the metrics each platform reported. Missing numbers stay blank, never zero.

loop.title: Learn
loop.body: Deterministic statistics compare your posts by platform, time slot, content pillar, hook, and format. A pattern only appears with at least five posts in the group and five outside it, with a 95% range on the effect.

loop.title: Recommend
loop.body: Opportunities turn those findings into concrete next steps with the numbers behind them: a window that beats your average, a platform that wins per post, a pattern worth repeating.

loop.title: Draft
loop.body: Draft this writes a caption in your brand voice from your own best-performing evidence and saves it to Content as a normal draft. You edit, add media, and schedule.

intelligence.tabsTitle: What You Get, Tab by Tab

tabs.title: Overview
tabs.body: Objective banner, measured KPIs, per-post platform comparison, a readiness list that shows which features are active and how much data each one still needs, and Ask Markaestro for questions answered only from this brand's records.

tabs.title: Content
tabs.body: Your posts ranked by the metric you chose, the patterns detected in each one, and a Why it worked explanation grounded in that post's numbers against your account average.

tabs.title: Playbook
tabs.body: Evidence-backed opportunities you can accept, pin, or dismiss, each with a Draft this button, plus the patterns that repeat in your data with sample size, effect, and confidence range spelled out. Accepting never creates or schedules a post.

tabs.title: Audience
tabs.body: Declare your objective, markets, timezone, pillars, and voice. Tracked short links count clicks without storing personal data and tie conversions back to the post.

tabs.title: Experiments
tabs.body: Paired A/B posts with a measured winner, available on the Business plan.

principles: Never publishes from a recommendation alone. Evergreen schedules only after you create and explicitly activate a queue.
Never fills in a number a platform did not report. Blank means blank.
Never uses other brands' data or generic benchmarks. Every claim comes from your own history.
Always says what fed a result: Measured, Calculated, Recommended, Declared, or Generated.
intelligence.plans: Audience Fit is on every plan. Playbook, Opportunities, tracked links, Ask Markaestro, and up to 10 Intelligent Evergreen queues per brand start on Pro; Business adds unlimited Evergreen queues and Experiments. AI actions such as Draft this are metered per month by plan.
